verdict.rationale: Forter is API-first: orders are sent programmatically to get fraud decisions, status updates and evidence are pushed via API, and a sandbox/TEST environment lets teams verify integrations before production, so it can be driven headlessly in automation. Nothing documents a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or test-automation tooling specifically. missing for 10: CLI or CI-specific tooling/docs, documented CI test patterns against the sandbox, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Send order information at checkout to receive a fraud or abuse decision.
Forter has both a production and a sandbox environment for your development process.
The main objective of the TEST site is to allow you to verify the integration prior to its deployment in the production environment.
Save time and effort by using our Evidence API endpoint to automatically send post-order evidence for chargeback disputes.
